title.en: How long did it take? Time duration

text.en: Raghav starts yoga at one time and finishes at another. How long did he practise? The time between two clock times is called the duration.

Duration means how much time has passed between a start and an end.
If both times have the same minutes, just subtract the hours. 3:18 p.m. to 8:18 p.m. is 5 hours.
If both times have the same hour, subtract the minutes. 1:15 p.m. to 1:42 p.m. is 27 minutes.
For 9:15 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. first count whole hours to 11:15, which is 2 hours, then 15 more minutes: 2 hours 15 minutes.
To compare times, write them in the same units. 1 h 20 min is 80 minutes, 2 h 10 min is 130 minutes and 1 h 35 min is 95 minutes. Rani took the longest and Raghav the least.
A stopwatch or a second hand is used when the duration is very small, such as skipping 10 times or writing your name.

problem.en: Find the time from 9:15 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.

prompt.en: How do you find the time that passed between 9:15 a.m. and 11:30 a.m.?

commonMisconceptions.en: Subtracting 9 from 11 and 15 from 30 separately in the wrong order

points.en: Duration is the time between a start and an end.
Subtract hours when minutes are the same, and minutes when hours are the same.
Convert to minutes to compare times such as 1 h 20 min and 2 h 10 min.
Use seconds for very short activities.
